metadata.title: NASA Audio Highlight Reels, Soundbites and Launch Sounds
metadata.creator: NASA
metadata.description:
All NASA audio highlight reels, in mp3 format.

Digitized, cataloged and archived by the Houston Audio Control Room, at the NASA Johnson Space Center.
subject: NASA; Audio Highlights
Mercury Audio Collection

reviews.reviewbody: I read about this in Mix magazine.  Thank you for all of the work going into this project, it is an audio treasure.

Another awesome collection for this archive.  Plenty of material here to listen to.  I would love to see some collections of Flight Director and MCC controller loops for the Apollo missions.
Quick message to John Stoll:  You have the best job in the world!  Many thanks for your efforts and to those like Gene Kranz for saving tapes.
hearing those audios from the apollo era does bring back some good memories
